name: adwety-backend
description: Complete ADWETY backend with authentication, pharmacy management, drugs database, inventory snapshots, search, Gemini AI prescription analysis, logging, admin APIs, and VPS/PM2 deployment support.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check app.js && find config controllers middleware models routes services utils scripts tests -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.security:check: node scripts/security-report-check.js && node scripts/security-phase2-check.js && node scripts/security-runtime-smoke.js && node scripts/security-phase3-check.js && node scripts/security-phase4-check.js && node scripts/security-grandfathering-check.js && npm run web-scope:check
scripts.security:critical-check: node scripts/security-report-check.js && node scripts/security-phase2-check.js && node scripts/security-runtime-smoke.js && node scripts/security-phase3-check.js && node scripts/security-phase4-check.js
scripts.security:all: npm run check && npm run security:check && npm run test:security:integration && npm audit --audit-level=high
